description: Untrusted users could roll back security updates when using the PackageKit Zypp Backend before 1.4.1, allowing privilege escalation.

A vulnerability was identified in sooperset mcp-atlassian up to 0.24.0. This issue affects the function validate_safe_path of the file src/mcp_atlassian/utils/io.py.
